name: Shiraishi Sakurako
source:
"I am a girl, and I am the student council president, so why do I have this dirty thing attached to me?!"

The student council president who excels in anything, whether it be sports or studies, she manages to get through them all fantastically. Her personality is as beautiful as her appearance is. Sakurako is adored and admired by all the students.
